desc:
Looking at how Suika treats Zanmu – it's almost like respect? There's none of that patronizing attitude; that she's almost wary of Zanmu as her match. Like, she will definitely put her guard up if Zanmu, say, visits Geidontei while she's hanging out there.

Anyway, Suika says this to Zanmu when she wins against her in [***UDoALG.***](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Unfinished_Dream_of_All_Living_Ghost/Story/Suika's_Script#Suika_defeats_Zanmu)
